Data extraction: CSV rows are positional Sequence nodes with indexed cells

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using TreeSitterLanguagePack;

var result = TreeSitterLanguagePackConverter.Process("a,b,c\n1,2,3\n", new ProcessConfig { DataExtraction = true, Language = "csv" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Data);
Console.WriteLine(result.Data!.Kind);
Console.WriteLine(result.Data!.Children);
```
